title: External benchmark readiness report with PgWire evidence
scope: Connect external benchmark tool/artifact gap reporting to the executable PgWire/JDBC catalog evidence from BENCHPROD-087.
constraints: Do not claim official benchmark compatibility when external artifacts are missing
Expose FusionDB-side readiness evidence next to external blockers

steps.step: Probe local external tool and jar availability
Extend external_smoke.py with PgWire evidence ingestion
Run external readiness report against latest PgWire catalog smoke

benchmark_changes: external_smoke.py accepts --pgwire-evidence and auto-discovers the latest pgwire_smoke run when omitted.
External reports now include FusionDB readiness evidence for PostgreSQL/PgWire/JDBC targets while preserving tool_missing or artifact_missing statuses.

No PostgreSQL JDBC, BenchBase, LDBC, or CH-benCHmark jar was found under E:/Playground using rg --files jar discovery.
tests: python -m py_compile pgwire_smoke.py fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py external_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py
